newsitem.title: USA: Mid Am Inc to post $8.5 mln gain from deal.
newsitem.headline: Mid Am Inc to post $8.5 mln gain from deal.

text.p: Mid Am Inc said Friday it has reached a definitive agreement to sell seven branches to Star Bank NA, and expects to post a $8.5 million gain when the deal is closed.
The seven AmeriFirst Bank NA branches are all in Ohio in: Cincinnati, Lebanon, Monroe, Montgomery and Kettering.
The transaction is expected to close early in the first quarter of 1997, it said. Star Bank, a unit of Star Banc Corp, is based in Cincinnati.
Mid Am said it was selling the branches as part of its strategy to refocus its resources on its core Greene County market area.
